messages:
Maya Rodriguez: Quick thread 1 1 1 1 compact billing canvas 1 where to surface invoice download and token breakdowns for org vs project scope? mock: https://redwood.app/mock/1859999000.png
Liam O'Connor: Two schools: inline icon per row (very discoverable) vs global toolbar download (cleaner header). accountants usually want per-row. :ledger:
Priya Nair: Accessibility: per-row icon needs aria-label and visible focus ring. Toolbar download needs clear scope selector ("selected / filtered / all") so screen readers understand what they'll get.
Maya Rodriguez: UX compromise idea: show a small per-row kebab that expands to actions (Download PDF, View tokens). That keeps density and avoids many buttons.
Liam O'Connor: kebab is good but discoverability for infrequent users? maybe add hover affordance and a persistent icon on hover/focus.
Priya Nair: Token breakdown: prefer inline collapse below the row with smooth motion and lazy-loading content. Popover breaks reading flow and keyboard users may lose context.
InfraBot: Perf note: virtualized lists + inline expands must keep DOM light. Use placeholder + fetch on expand.
Maya Rodriguez: Copy suggestion for kebab actions: "Download invoice (PDF)" and "Show token breakdown". Add sr-only context: org/project and billing period.
Liam O'Connor: A/B test proposal: variant A = row kebab primary; variant B = toolbar primary with bulk download. Metrics: downloads per session, keyboard interactions, support tickets.
Priya Nair: Accessibility acceptance criteria: 1) aria-label includes scope & period; 2) keyboard focusable and discoverable; 3) expand/collapse announced via aria-live.
Maya Rodriguez: I'll update Figma with kebab + inline expand, include microcopy and link. Posting frames by EOD.
